_disclaimer: RESEARCHED AND INDEPENDENTLY CROSS-CHECKED, BUT STILL NOT HUMAN-VERIFIED. All 50 states + DC have now been researched TWICE by separate automated research passes that could not see each other's results, then diffed against each other. Where both passes independently landed on the same figures from official .gov sources, confidence is meaningfully higher (see per-state notes for 'reconfirmed'/'cross-validated' language) - but two AI passes agreeing is still not the same as a human or the state DOT confirming it, so needsVerification stays true on every record, including the highest-confidence ones. Where the two passes disagreed, the more conservative (smaller/more restrictive) figure was kept and the conflict is flagged explicitly in notes for priority human review - do not treat those numbers as resolved. Width and weight generally reflect the federal Interstate/National Network baseline (23 U.S.C. 127: 102in legal width, 80,000 lbs legal GVW subject to the Federal Bridge Formula) unless a state-specific figure was found and confirmed. Height varies most by state. Length is simplified to a single flat number and does NOT model states that use a kingpin-to-rear-axle (KPRA) formula instead (flagged in notes where known). Permit tiers labeled '(ceiling not state-confirmed - generic placeholder)' are still not real state-specific numbers. Every record must be confirmed against the actual state DOT permit office before being used for a real go/no-go legal or permit decision.
